Inside the window (2026-11-12 close to 2026-11-13 close); the call itself lands inside the window too.
conviction_note: No usable chain, so abs_move is set from 132% annualised 20d realised vol (about 8.3% a day) and the name's own confirmed print reactions (1Q26 -15% on 2026-05-07; 2Q26 opened -5.4%, closed +0.2% on 2026-08-06), then raised because Nubank and StoneCo also report the same evening; p_up 48 because the quarter itself (Jul-Sep, pre-election) is pre-flagged and two analysts' bars agree on a flat QoQ R$425-429m, while the move turns on the 13 Nov call's 2027 tone after Lula's re-election and the Copom pause. Findings sum -0.6 against a scaled -0.4: same sign, same order, both near zero.
bar: 3Q26 net income R$429m (Itau BBA) and R$425m (Safra), ROE 16% / 15.8%, Safra NPL90 5.7% (2Q26 5.3%), cost of risk 6.1%, NIM -32bp QoQ, both roughly flat on 2Q26's R$421m: https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/noticias-sobre-fintechs/fintechs-vao-lucrar-mais-no-3t26-mas-mercado-ja-ve-problemas-para-2027/ (two agreeing estimate sources). USD EPS bar disputed: $0.16 (https://tradersunion.com/stocks/earnings/intr-usd/) vs $0.19 on 3 estimates (https://therighttrader.com/earnings-calendar/intr), Yahoo range $0.18-0.20. Company guide: 2026 cost of risk ~6%, NIM +10bp/quarter, coverage 130-135%, loan growth 25-30% (https://quartr.com/events/inter-co-inc-intr-q2-2026_FkpGVDLA ; https://www.seudinheiro.com/2026/empresas/inter-inbr32-ainda-nao-viu-o-pior-inadimplencia-deve-subir-no-3t26-ceo-revela-de-onde-vem-a-pressao-miql/).
positioning_check: Short interest 8.41M shares, about 3.4% of float, 1.9 days to cover at the 2026-09-30 settlement (https://massive.com/quote/intr ; https://fintel.io/s/us/intr, which shows 0.79 DTC undated). Earlier 7.5M / 1.0 DTC at 2026-08-14 (https://curvedtrading.com/stocks/intr/short-interest/). Not a crowded short. No option skew: chain unusable (ATM legs not two-sided), put/call open-interest ratio 0.14 on 8,575 contracts, so call-heavy open interest (sealed baseline). Tape: spot 3.945, -41.6% over 20 sessions, -61% from the 52-week high, 4.4% above the 52-week low, 20d realised vol 132%. The forced seller (Bradesco's BDR sales facility, 12.28M shares) finished by the 2026-11-10 6-K.

findings.finding: Management pre-announced that 3Q26 delinquency would rise: on 2026-09-25 CEO Riccio said there is 'a bigger delinquency cycle we have to go through', with 90+ NPL already up from 5.1% to 5.3% and 15-90 from 4.6% to 4.8% through June, partly from private-payroll (consignado privado) operational problems. Safra's bar already carries NPL90 at 5.7% and cost of risk at 6.1%, against a company guide of about 6%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This line moved the stock before. 1Q26 (2026-05-07): record profit of R$395m, but NPL90 rose to 5.1% and the stock fell about 15% (https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/noticias-sobre-fintechs/inter-cai-na-propria-armadilha-e-afunda-mais-de-7-na-nasdaq/). 2Q26: cost of risk rose 33bp and the stock opened -5.4% but closed +0.2% (https://www.riotimesonline.com/?p=694049).
findings.why_not_priced: It is largely priced: the CEO said it in public and Safra's bar already has 5.7%. What is unpriced is only how far a print lands from 5.7%. If NPL90 prints above about 6%, or cost of risk well above the ~6% guide, that would be new. Within the 5.5-5.8% range it is a reported-quarter item the market was told to expect.
findings.independence: Safra's estimate (finsiders 3T26 preview, https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/noticias-sobre-fintechs/fintechs-vao-lucrar-mais-no-3t26-mas-mercado-ja-ve-problemas-para-2027/) and Itau BBA's June note that provisions would pressure the next quarters (https://www.seudinheiro.com/2026/empresas/inter-intr-ficou-barato-itau-bba-corta-preco-alvo-e-diz-o-que-ainda-trava-uma-alta-das-acoes-miql/). Both are sell-side, not company data.

findings.finding: Management's own forward statement before the election: on 2026-09-28 the CEO said the NPL ratio had stabilised and he expects improvement in 4Q26, and that the private-payroll operational bottlenecks (Dataprev/eSocial relinking) were being corrected from September with regularisation expected in October-November. He also moved the 30% ROE target from 2027 to 2029, going via 20% first. Whether the 13 Nov call reaffirms the 4Q26 improvement is the guidance line.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The target framework has been sold before. The 60-30-30 / Rule of 50 Owners' Day (2026-05-11) fell 7.4% that day and 13.9% over five sessions. Investors doubted the targets, and executives called them direction rather than guidance (https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/noticias-sobre-fintechs/inter-cai-na-propria-armadilha-e-afunda-mais-de-7-na-nasdaq/).
findings.why_not_priced: The statement predates the 2026-10-25 runoff and the 42% fall since. If the market believed a 4Q26 NPL turn, a name posting about 16% ROE would not trade near its 52-week low after a 61% drawdown, with Citi's target cut to $4. A reaffirmation on the call, with October/November payroll data showing the operational NPL clearing, would be new to the price.
findings.independence: Economist Rafaela Vitoria, quoted in the 2026-09-25 piece, expects delinquency to peak in 3Q26 (https://www.seudinheiro.com/2026/empresas/inter-inbr32-ainda-nao-viu-o-pior-inadimplencia-deve-subir-no-3t26-ceo-revela-de-onde-vem-a-pressao-miql/). This is the same outlet and the same company source, so the two are not fully independent.

findings.finding: After the quarter closed, the macro behind the 2027 guide worsened. Lula won the 2026-10-25 runoff, the real fell about 8% on 10-26, and Brazilian fintechs fell 25-37% (INTR -36%). On 2026-11-04 the Copom unanimously held the Selic at 13.75%, ending five cuts and citing a worse domestic and external environment, against 39 of 75 houses that expected a cut. System household NPL is at series highs (free-credit individuals about 8.1% in September). For a lender funding fixed-rate payroll, real-estate and card books with CDI deposits, higher-for-longer rates threaten NIM and cost of risk in the 2027 outlook.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: INTR fell 34-37% on 2026-10-26 on the election alone (https://tickeron.com/blogs/why-is-inter-co-intr-stock-down-34-08-today-21902/), and fell 5.4% in the week of 2026-11-02 to 06 as sector notes turned to 2027 (https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/?p=376291). No print has yet been read against this macro.
findings.why_not_priced: Mostly priced: the stock is -42% over 20 sessions, at the sector's pace. What is not yet in the price is management's own transmission (any cut to 2026 loan growth of 25-30%, a NIM guide below +10bp a quarter, cost of risk above 6%, or a later ROE path). Those are only visible on the 13 Nov call. If the market had fully priced a guide cut, INTR would have rebounded on the 2026-11-10 seller completion, and it fell 1%.
findings.independence: This is a macro proxy, not confirmed by Inter. Bradesco 3Q26 (2026-10-22) showed NPL90 up to 4.6% from 4.3%, higher retail delinquency and coverage down to 142.6% (https://www.bloomberglinea.com.br/negocios/lucro-do-bradesco-perde-folego-no-3-tri-com-alta-da-inadimplencia-e-das-provisoes/). Household NPL record: https://paraibabusiness.com.br/endividamento-das-familias-chega-a-501-da-renda-em-agosto-informa-bc/ . Election shock: https://aljazeera.com/economy/2026/10/26/brazils-real-sinks-after-lulas-re-election-victory

findings.finding: The forced seller is finished. Under the 2026-11-10 6-K, Bradesco, as depositary, sold all 12,281,668 Class A shares in the BDR sales facility, which could run from 2026-10-19 to 11-17 and allowed block sales at a discount. The overhang ended before the print, a week ahead of its outside deadline. 12.3M shares is about 0.84 days of the 20d average volume (14.6M).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No earlier instance. The stock fell 1.0% on the 6-K day (2026-11-10, sealed baseline) and is up 4.4% over 5 sessions.
findings.why_not_priced: It was public two days before the print, so it is mostly priced. What remains is that no mechanical seller sits under a post-print bounce. Before the 6-K, a positive print could have been sold into by a best-efforts depositary until 11-17. Small, because the volume was under one day's turnover.
findings.independence: The facility terms (2026-10-19 6-K, https://s3.amazonaws.com/sec.irpass.cc/2728/0001864163-26-000083.htm) and Quiver's 2026-10-26 attribution of part of the fall to the facility (https://www.quiverquant.com/news/Why+Inter+%26+Co+%28INTR%29+Stock+Is+Down+Today). Same issuer documents.

findings.finding: Safra expects NIM to fall 32bp QoQ in 3Q26 because 2Q26's IPCA-linked gain does not repeat. Management guides NIM expansion of about 10bp a quarter, and 2Q26 NIM was a record above 10%. A printed NIM decline would sit outside the company's own guide even if it lands on Safra's bar.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: In 2Q26 EPS beat ($0.19 vs $0.18) but revenue missed by about 7% ($475.5M vs $512.6M), and the stock opened -5.4% and closed flat (https://therighttrader.com/earnings-calendar/intr ; https://www.riotimesonline.com/?p=694049).
findings.source_date: 2026-11 (article cites the 2026-10-27 Citi downgrades and 2026-10-13 prices; exact day not shown)
findings.why_not_priced: It is in one broker's numbers and the Q2 headline was 'NIM above 10% for the first time'. A reader anchored on the +10bp/quarter guide expects expansion. The revenue-line miss pattern from 2Q26 is the risk. If priced, the USD revenue consensus ($548.8M) would already embed a NIM decline, and it implies growth above 2Q26's $475.5M.
findings.independence: Company NIM guide: https://quartr.com/events/inter-co-inc-intr-q2-2026_FkpGVDLA . The finding shares a document with the bar.

findings.finding: The sell-side capitulated into the print. On 2026-11-05 Citi cut its INTR target to $4, close to spot, citing credit costs and the buyout of the rest of Inter Seguros. Itau BBA (June) had cut 2026/2027 net income to R$1.7bn/R$2.1bn, and Citi (May) and Santander downgraded to neutral. With the bar lowered and ratings neutral, an in-line print meets low expectations.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: INTR fell 5.39% in the week of the Citi cut (https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/?p=376291). No print-day evidence on how a lowered bar is treated.
findings.why_not_priced: The cut itself is wire copy and priced. The small residual is that a $4 target from a former Buy leaves little room for further downgrades on an in-line quarter. If the market still expected more cuts, short interest would have built, and it was 3.4% of float at 9-30.
findings.independence: Itau BBA target cut to $8 and earnings cuts, 2026-06-23 (https://www.seudinheiro.com/2026/empresas/inter-intr-ficou-barato-itau-bba-corta-preco-alvo-e-diz-o-que-ainda-trava-uma-alta-das-acoes-miql/). Citi downgrade, May 2026 (https://www.streetinsider.com/rating_history.php?q=intr).

findings.finding: Capital use: on 2026-10-19 Banco Inter agreed to buy the remaining 39.75% of Inter Seguros from Wiz for R$409.5M (CDI-adjusted, paid at closing, subject to BCB and CADE approval). That is about one quarter of net income, spent on a fee business it already consolidates, at a time when the stock trades near book.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Announced on 2026-10-19. That day's matched 6-K row in the baseline shows +5.2% / +2.5%, but those rows also cover the BDR notice. Citi cited the purchase among its concerns on 2026-11-05.
findings.why_not_priced: The deal was announced, but its multiple and its CET1 effect are not. The call will be asked whether buying back minority insurance beats buying back stock at about 1x book or below. What the money buys is 100% of an existing fee stream, not a growth ramp, so the sign is slightly negative, not distress.
findings.independence: Citi's concern per finsiders (https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/?p=376291). Same deal, second reader.

findings.finding: Leadership change after the quarter: on 2026-10-13 a 6-K said Alexandre Riccio, CEO of Brazil, moves to group SVP COO over credit, collections and operations, and becomes Executive Vice Chairman. Francisco Santos, ex-CEO of Midway (Guararapes' financial arm), joins as Chief Growth Officer for Brazil monetisation. No successor CEO for Brazil is named and there are no effective dates.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026-10-13 row in the sealed baseline shows -3.75%.
findings.why_not_priced: The headline is priced. It is unresolved what putting the former Brazil CEO in charge of credit and collections signals about the 4Q26 credit plan. Read one way it is a credit-quality fix, read the other a sign the credit book needed one. The call is the first time the market hears it explained.

findings.finding: A peer read lands before Inter speaks. PicPay pre-guided 3Q26 adjusted net income of R$265M, -6% QoQ, after NPL90 rose to 9.8% in 2Q26. In the 2026-11-02 to 06 week the US-listed Brazilian fintechs fell 4-8% (except NU and XP) as sell-side notes focused on a 2027 slowdown. Agibank reported on 11-11 after the close; its results were not found.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No measured read-across history for INTR.
findings.why_not_priced: It is a peer proxy with a different, riskier book (PicPay NPL90 9.8% vs Inter's 5.3%), so its transmission to Inter is weak. If the sector bar were already reset, the pre-guide would not have come with a weekly fall.
findings.independence: This is a proxy and shares the finsiders weekly with the Citi finding. PicPay 2Q26 NPL detail: https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/noticias-sobre-fintechs/fintechs-vao-lucrar-mais-no-3t26-mas-mercado-ja-ve-problemas-para-2027/

findings.finding: Correlated same-night prints: Nubank and StoneCo also report 3Q26 on 2026-11-12 after the close, the same session as Inter (StoneCo per its own release). Their numbers and calls are a sector read inside this window, of unknown sign, and widen the move rather than set its direction.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Sector beta is extreme: on 2026-10-26 the group fell 25-37% together (https://www.tikr.com/blog/stoneco-sinks-29-inter-co-down-36-pagseguro-down-25-on-lulas-unexpected-election-win?.tsrc=rss).
findings.why_not_priced: Its direction cannot be priced before the releases. It is filed so the judges see that the variance is higher than a single-name print.
findings.independence: Finsiders lists Nubank, Inter and Stone all on 11-12 (https://finsidersbrasil.com.br/noticias-sobre-fintechs/fintechs-vao-lucrar-mais-no-3t26-mas-mercado-ja-ve-problemas-para-2027/).

outside_window.finding: The final per-BDR payment amount and payment date for the sales facility are still to be published, and the INBR32 programme formally ends around 2026-11-17/18. This is administrative and carries no further share sales.
Closing of the Inter Seguros 39.75% buyout depends on BCB and CADE approval, with no date given.

baseline_tension: There is no skew to agree or disagree with. The run-up is -42% over 20 sessions, mostly a sector-wide election shock, so the slightly negative lean (2027 guide risk) agrees with the run-up and is largely priced. The forced-seller completion, the low short interest and the sell-side capitulation cut the other way, which is why p_up sits near 50.
lessons_applied: Rule 6 (inside what was guided): the pre-flagged 3Q26 NPL rise moved from -0.5 to -0.2, because management told the market and Safra's bar carries it.
Rule 5 (macro-to-company proxy): the election/Copom guidance finding moved from -1.0 to -0.8, kept and labelled as a proxy; the PicPay peer read moved from -0.3 to -0.2.

Untrustworthy-history lesson: the baseline's 2.51% median (monthly 6-Ks) was discarded and the base rate rebuilt from confirmed prints (-15%, +0.2%). abs_move_pct raised from 9 to 10 on the understatement record and the same-night Nubank/StoneCo prints.
Rule 6 (bar): the net-income bar is sourced to two agreeing estimates (Itau BBA R$429m, Safra R$425m), so no cap; the USD EPS bar is disputed and nothing is sized on it.
Rule 7: short interest checked (3.4% of float, 1.9 DTC) before the negatives; it is not crowded, so the negatives were not shrunk further.
Left standing: forward-guide finding +0.8, seller completion +0.4, Citi capitulation +0.3, Inter Seguros -0.2, leadership -0.2, same-night prints 0.
